info.title: PGC Vehicle Import Tax Estimate Action
info.description: GPT Action contract for the PGC server-side vehicle import tax estimator. Send only structured fiscal DTO data; never send raw documents, free documentary text, PII, vehicle identifiers, plates, secrets or credential material. Runtime body limit is 256 KiB.

post.summary: Estimate Spanish fiscal costs for an imported vehicle from structured evidence.
post.description: Build a strict vehicle_tax_action_request.v1 DTO from sanitized fiscal evidence, then let the PGC server-side adapter, case-file builder and orchestrator calculate. Do not include derived results, unstructured documentary content, file payloads, URLs, PII, vehicle identifiers, plates or secrets.

sufficientCase.summary: Synthetic case with enough structured data for IVTM and DGT readiness.

bearerAuth.description: Opaque token configured outside this OpenAPI document in GPT Action authentication settings. Never paste the secret into this document or chat.

CaseId.description: Opaque case id; never use personal or vehicle identifiers.

calculationDate.description: Real calendar date in ISO YYYY-MM-DD format. Its year must match taxYear; runtime performs the authoritative semantic validation.

anyOf.description: ISO year-month when the exact day is not evidenced.
